propositions: binding_store.py at 787 LOC is 13 lines below the 800-line module-size gate cap, risking build failure when the next contributor touches the file

the last-synced peer-state cluster (ADR-0026 baseline functions and _BASELINE_FIELDS, ~130 LOC) is a cohesive concern distinct from binding lifecycle and can be extracted into a new peer_state.py module without coupling
extracting peer-state functions as module-level helpers with thin BindingStore delegates preserves the public surface unchanged, so no call sites or test doubles require editing

the peer-state functions lack direct unit testability when nested in BindingStore and should be testable standalone, especially to pin absence-semantics guarantees (absent baseline -> local-wins, absent peer parent -> no clear)
